about: What alpha.2's element-log reader (cf3af5d = ae-t2-done = ae-alpha.2, lib/core/element-log.js createElementLog's index(), the switch at :611-680) does with each record type, and which schema each built-in type's manifest reads there. A record whose `t` is listed under `indexed` is indexed only when every field listed passes its kind (else alpha.2 counts it `skipped`); any other `t` falls to the default arm, which counts it `unknown` and ignores it. The field kinds' patterns are cf3af5d's own (ELEMENT_ID_RE :128, ACK_KEY_RE :132, ANSWER_CODE_RE :140, ANSWER_HASH_RE :142, PIN_V_RE :324; answerItemProblem :153-174 with ANSWER_KEYS :149, ANSWER_STATES = the first three ANCHOR_STATES, ANSWER_PEERS, ANSWER_DEVICES and ANSWER_RECORD_MAX :139-147). test/elements-e2e-t3.test.js's AG-1 step holds every record of a tranche-3 project to this table, so a tranche-3 log rolled back to alpha.2 reads without a skipped record; a version whose schema no type below reads is one alpha.2's draw parks (C-5).
derived_by: for t in box-grab comment highlight; do git show cf3af5d:templates/elements/web-chat-builtins/elements/$t/element.json; done
